title: Minority Report
creator: Steven Spielberg
invention: A gestural interface for moving through data on a screen with the hands
caseCredit: REPLACE: Tom Cruise as John Anderton in Minority Report (2002)

tech.name: Microsoft Surface (PixelSense)
tech.description: A table-sized multi-touch computer that several people could use at once and that recognised objects placed on it. Demonstrated in 2007, renamed PixelSense in 2012.

references.title: Matt Weinberger, "Microsoft's very first Surface was this largely forgotten coffee table sized-tablet that Bill Gates loved," Business Insider

tech.name: Kinect
tech.description: A motion-sensing add-on for the Xbox 360 that tracks the body and hands without a controller. Programmers used it to build interfaces modelled on the film's.
